paragraphs: The role of Machine Learning Engineer, Memory at Epic Games calls for designing new memory architectures that work across problems, modalities and products, and for helping create and deliver production‑ready, scalable and high‑quality learning models and associated algorithms. You will work with researchers on projects across the company that require memory in different modalities to define general solutions that enable models to represent experience, decide what they keep and what they discard, and to efficiently store, retrieve and exploit memory. Being Epic means being part of a team that continually strives to do right by your community and users, while Unreal projects lead the pack of real‑time entertainment with a constantly growing team of engineering experts.

The requirement for Expert is met by my hands‑on experience building interactive systems. I have employed JavaScript to develop pricing logic that responds instantly to market changes, and I have implemented WebSocket‑based agent streaming to maintain low‑latency communication channels for real‑time data flow. These projects demonstrate my ability to deliver precise, high‑performance solutions in fast‑moving environments.

The machine learning requirement aligns with my extensive work using scikit‑learn, TensorFlow and Keras to construct and optimise models, and deploying them via FastAPI within Docker containers for reliable production use. I have applied feature engineering, cross‑validation and hyperparameter tuning to improve both classification and regression tasks, ensuring models are both accurate and scalable. This experience equips me to design and evaluate memory‑centric learning systems that meet Epic Games’ high standards.
